feature_definitions.*_delta_25: feature change from the preceding 25-expansion snapshot
feature_definitions.*_delta_from_25: feature change from the first snapshot at expansion 25
feature_definitions.arena_per_expansion: arena size divided by decision expansion N
feature_definitions.cutoff_nodes: arena entries at a staged depth cutoff
feature_definitions.distinct_expanded_nodes: distinct arena IDs expanded so far
feature_definitions.distinct_fraction: distinct expanded nodes divided by N
feature_definitions.max_depth: maximum placement depth represented in the arena
feature_definitions.max_node_expansions: largest expansion count for one arena ID
feature_definitions.open_fraction: open nodes divided by arena size
feature_definitions.open_nodes: arena entries whose node is still Unexpanded
feature_definitions.reselected_expansions: expansions beyond first expansion of an arena ID
feature_definitions.root_child_dn_sum: sum of current root-child DN values
feature_definitions.root_child_pn_sum: sum of current root-child PN values
feature_definitions.top1_pn..top4_dn: PN/DN of up to four root children ordered by current selection score
feature_definitions.top_dn_gap_12: DN gap between selection-score ranks 1 and 2
feature_definitions.top_pn_gap_12: PN gap between selection-score ranks 1 and 2
feature_definitions.tt_admission_rejections: cumulative index admissions refused by the byte cap
feature_definitions.tt_entries: positions admitted to the capped exact-key index
feature_definitions.tt_index_fraction: indexed entries divided by arena size
